notes: All listed JSONL entry points are real files rather than absolute-path symlinks.
H2S-Dataset contains 4,228 SFT records and 2,419 RL records from 11 benchmark families.
Use rl_swift_train_128k.jsonl for the first 128K ms-swift GRPO phase and rl_swift_train.jsonl for a later long-context phase.
rl_swift_train.jsonl excludes three empirically confirmed contradictory records; rl.jsonl and rl_swift.jsonl remain intact for auditability.
MSMARCO-Rerank is not present in the active RL pool.
Verify this package from the data directory with sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.sha256.

rl_swift_train_128k.jsonl.purpose: recommended phase-1 GRPO input with room for an 8192-token completion inside the 135168-token SFT budget

rl_reward_quarantine.json.purpose: auditable exclusion list for contradictory FinalAnswer and evidence supervision

id_with_block_id.jsonl.purpose: in-distribution evaluation with stable BLOCK_ID sections

ood_with_block_id.jsonl.purpose: out-of-distribution evaluation with stable BLOCK_ID sections
